summary: Fusion Module released with a concrete therapy/home/school observation comparison, selected professional adjustment, next checkpoint and four-step accessible diagram. Nine matched FAQs, source/Markdown/social content and contextual PinnacleAI/therapy links align. Pushed CI, physical iPhone/Safari and public checks passed; 194 routes/four bindings and19 protected pages preserved. One changed-URL IndexNow notification accepted.

faqs.q: What is the Fusion Module in PinnacleAI?
faqs.a: Fusion is PinnacleAI’s tracking and correction module. It brings relevant observations from therapy, home and, where appropriate and consented, school into professional review so the team can decide what to keep, adapt, pause or investigate next.

faqs.q: Why can a skill work in therapy but look different at home or school?
faqs.a: The people, environment, timing, activity and support may differ. Fusion’s review keeps those details with the child’s response so the professional can investigate the difference instead of treating all observations as equivalent.

faqs.q: What should a parent bring into a progress review?
faqs.a: Bring one specific everyday example: what was happening, where, who was present, what support or cue was offered and how your child responded. Include the child’s choices and comfort. Share it through the agreed care channel, not in public comments.

faqs.q: Does Fusion automatically change my child’s therapy?
faqs.a: No. Relevant observations inform professional interpretation. The professional discusses appropriate changes with the family and explains what to observe next; a rating alone is not an autonomous treatment decision.

faqs.q: Does every child need input from school or several different raters?
faqs.a: No. Relevant contributors depend on the child’s circumstances. School input requires appropriate consent and authorised access; the described rater roles do not mean that every role contributes to every child’s record.

faqs.q: What if my child does not want to continue an activity?
faqs.a: The child’s choice, comfort and accessible way to pause or decline belong in the review. The professional can adapt or pause the support and reconsider the goal. Completing an activity is not the only useful information.

faqs.q: How does Fusion connect with reassessment and the other therapies?
faqs.a: Fusion connects everyday observations with the next support decision. Reassessment compares the broader ability and readiness picture over time. Speech, occupational, behavioural and educational contributions are included according to the child’s goals and professional judgement, not as a compulsory bundle.

faqs.q: Do the licences guarantee progress for my child?
faqs.a: The BIS schedule names Fusion within the software quality-system scope. MD-5 defines PinnacleAI’s non-diagnostic developmental-support intended use. These records do not guarantee an individual outcome; your child’s actual response remains central to review.

faqs.q: How can we begin a conversation with Pinnacle?
faqs.a: Call 9100 181 181, find a Pinnacle centre or use the enrolment page. Tell us one everyday activity you want to make easier. Telephone guidance is free; the team will explain the suitable professional, centre, first visit and fees before you decide.
